families.name: baryon
families.why: Only native member. Official precision record remains FAIL. Not an MLE.

families.name: mond_ptqnu
families.mapping: a0 = epsilon * c * H0; shared U and ln_sigma
families.why: The two accepted vectors are different physical points. ptq-nu has a completed fine192 precision pass. mond is lower by about 0.056 but its official coarse96 record is FAIL. The other native vector is produced by exact mapping and checked, not by a second optimization.

families.name: ptq_linear
families.why: Not a MOND reparameterization. Wide epsilon bounds stay. Precision pass does not imply stationarity or an MLE.

families.name: screen
families.mapping: a0 = epsilon * c * H0; q = exp(ln q); shared U and ln_sigma
families.why: Objectives differ. ptq-screen has a finished precision record that remains FAIL. mond-screen stopped before an independent terminal validation. Mapping writes the other native vector. Neither point is an MLE.

families.name: nfw1p
families.proposed_start: original P1A start, which is also the P1G-A terminal because accepted iterations were zero
families.why: No optimizer batch has been run. The start is not a corrected-B0 MLE. Full-covariance historical logL is a different likelihood.

scheduler.matched_pair_identity_check: two full fine192 samples after mapping, charged to contingency
scheduler.on_budget_limit: retain last atomically committed accepted theta; discard the in-flight trial
scheduler.accepted_commit: tmp file, fsync, os.replace, directory fsync; theta and objective metadata in the same record

b1_policy.action: fixed-point evaluation at the accepted B0 theta only
b1_policy.reason: P1G-A reached B1 only as a budget error with no likelihood value. The 45-minute contingency is already assigned to preflight, mapping checks and bookkeeping.
